messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the outage: rehydrate was restoring payload but not ownership epoch, allowing stale-owner writes to win later.
jon: Reproduce steps?
kevin: Demote on node A, rehydrate on B; A had pending apply that races and applies after B's rehydrate because we accepted writes without epoch checks.
anya: Fix: add claim_epoch to handshake and require op_epoch >= stored_epoch for any mutating op (including evict).
sam: Agree. Also extend rehydrate response to include backend_expiry so we mirror TTL.
maria: Metrics: emit prefix_apply_rejected_total{reason="epoch_mismatch"} and prefix_ttl_skew_seconds.
jon: Rollout: proto change optional, but coordinate owners-before-writers during upgrade. Add mixed-version simulator test.
kevin: I'll open proto + runtime tickets and prototype.
anya: I'll add simulator and unit tests.
deploy-bot: reminder: update proto-compatibility doc and alert infra for canary retention.
maria: Thanks — will write RFC follow-up and assign tickets.
